crossRefs.note: He who is emasculated by crushing or cutting shall not enter into Yahweh’s assembly.
crossRefs.keyword: a dwarf. or, too slender. or hath

translations.web: or hunchbacked, or a dwarf, or one who has a defect in his eye, or an itching disease, or scabs, or who has damaged testicles.
translations.bsb: or who is a hunchback or dwarf, or who has an eye defect, a festering rash, scabs, or a crushed testicle.
translations.kjv: Or crookbackt, or a dwarf, or that hath a blemish in his eye, or be scurvy, or scabbed, or hath his stones broken;
translations.asv: or crook-backed, or a dwarf, or that hath a blemish in his eye, or is scurvy, or scabbed, or hath his stones broken;
